name: Energy Drink
function: Instantly restores half of your personal energy.

name: EScooter Battery Pack
function: Instantly fully recharges your e-scooter battery, but you must be near the scooter.

name: Ice Pack
function: Keeps a selected insulated-bag compartment at -8°C for the rest of the run; consumes one pack from inventory.

name: Heat Pack
function: Keeps a selected insulated-bag compartment at 60°C for the rest of the run; consumes one pack from inventory.
